pitfalls_injected.detail: 40 legacy_syslog lines carry a <13> priority prefix before the timestamp, pushing it off offset 0.
8 lines are a proprietary pipe-delimited format with no standard name; expected shape token = pipe/5 (5 fields).
csv_audit rows use DD/MM/YYYY throughout, but 6 of 12 rows (day=04, month=03) are ambiguous with MM/DD/YYYY since day<=12.
One csv_audit row has a quoted field containing an embedded comma ('Login from Sydney, AU'), which naive comma-splitting would miscount as 5 fields instead of 4.

fingerprint_notes: FREE_TEXT lines should bucket separately and not inflate the structural fingerprint count.
